subject: Cache eviction latency surge — confirmation of impact and postmortem / credit request
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@appwave.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: AppWave Support <support@appwave.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Aug 2029 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Cache eviction caused surge in tail latency — impact window & credits?

Hi Jonas,

Heads up — our ops team saw a large tail-latency spike this morning across checkout endpoints that lines up to a cache eviction in your sidecar (we're on the hosted API). Symptoms: generation latencies jumping to 6–12s, occasional 503s, user-facing timeouts. First alert: 09:05 PDT; we saw elevated error/rate between ~09:06 and ~09:27 (roughly).

Questions:
- Can Redwood confirm an eviction/kv-cache purge event in that window?
- If confirmed, what's the precise impacted window you will record for SLA purposes?
- We'll need an estimate of eligible credits under our SLA and a timeline for the postmortem. This incident affected a percentage of our transactions in that region — we're pulling exact revenue impact but wanted to escalate immediately.

Please advise and let me know if you need traces or sample request IDs.

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
Head of Infrastructure, AppWave
liam.oneill@appwave.com
[AppWave HQ — San Francisco]
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@appwave.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Aug 2029 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cache eviction caused surge in tail latency — impact window & credits?

Hi Liam — thanks for the flag and sorry about the disruption. We saw the alert on our side as well and I've looped in SRE (Marcus) and Customer Ops (Laura).

A few quick asks so we can triage fast:
- Can you send a couple of sample request IDs or a short timeframe (if you have more granular markers than 09:06–09:27)?
- Any specific endpoints that saw the highest error rates (checkout/generate/batch embedding)?

Immediate plan: Marcus will pull the cache eviction and routing traces and provide a preliminary impacted window. We'll confirm whether this meets SLA criteria (availability vs. transient error thresholds) and route the credit calculation to billing. We'll also commit to a postmortem with a proposed RCA timeline (target: initial RCA summary within 72 hours).

I'll follow up with the preliminary window within the hour.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@appwave.com>, AppWave Support <support@appwave.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Aug 2029 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cache eviction caused surge in tail latency — impact window & credits?

On Mon, 12 Aug 2029 at 09:30, jonas_weber@redwood.ai wrote:
> A few quick asks so we can triage fast: ...

Quick update from SRE: we observed an automated global prefix KV eviction in the serving runtime at 16:06:45 UTC (09:06:45 PDT) — likely triggered by a transient memory pressure during a brief autoscaler activity. Kernel-level metrics and the KV-layer show eviction events with a large writeback/rehydration cascade that plateaued by ~16:27:12 UTC (09:27:12 PDT).

Prelim impacted window (server-observed): 2029-08-12T16:06:45Z to 2029-08-12T16:27:12Z. During this interval we see sustained increase in 95/99p latencies and an uptick in 503s for our generation endpoints in the us-west-2 serving fleet.

Attached: short trace bundle and kv-stats snapshot.
[Attachment: kv-cache-eviction-trace-20290812.tar.gz (log bundle, 4.2 MB)]

Next steps:
- I'll hand this to the RCA rotation for a deeper root cause and mitigation plan.
- Jonas / Laura: please confirm if the window above aligns with AppWave telemetry. If so we'll start the SLA eligibility sweep and route the request to Billing for credit calc.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@appwave.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: AppWave Support <support@appwave.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Aug 2029 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cache eviction caused surge in tail latency — impact window & credits?

Thanks Marcus — that window matches our traces (we see the same spike starting at 09:06:42 PDT and tapering around 09:27:10 PDT). Impacted endpoints: /v1/generate (highest), /v1/chat/completions (secondary).

We've started an internal impact assessment — estimated 3.8% of checkout requests timed out or returned errors during the window. This is material for our business today (promotions running). We'll need:
- Formal SLA eligibility confirmation and credit calculation.
- A postmortem with root cause and remediation plan (target delivery by Friday EOD, if possible).

Also please open an official case ID so our procurement team can reference it for billing adjustments.

Liam
